t: Everything he asked to have covered
a: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي هَزْلِي وَجِدِّي وَخَطَاىَ وَعَمْدِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي
p: Allāhumma-ghfir lī khaṭīʾatī wa jahlī wa isrāfī fī amrī, wa mā anta aʿlamu bihi minnī. Allāhumma-ghfir lī hazlī wa jiddī wa khaṭāya wa ʿamdī, wa kullu dhālika ʿindī
m: O Allah, forgive me my error and my ignorance and my going too far in my affairs, and what You know better than I do. O Allah, forgive me my joking and my seriousness, my accidents and my deliberate acts. All of that is in me.
